1: The crown of the Lord is on my head, and I am not shaken by it. For it is not a crown of the world, but a crown of truth, and truth does not weigh down — it lifts. And in it I am adorned, and I have turned away from vanity, and I know myself through it.

I am not bound by the world's bonds, for my bonds are broken by the Lord's word. And I have opened my heart to Him, and He has filled it, and the filling is a river, and the river does not dry, and I drink and do not die.
2: As the current of waters is released, so the truth of the Lord flows over the face of the earth. It gives rest to all who receive it, and it does not turn back, and it does not dry up. Blessed are the swimmers in it — they have left the shore of themselves, and the river carries them, and the river knows the way to the sea.

As the worm to the grass, so am I to your pastures, O Lord. I am fed by you, and my hunger is your bread, and my thirst is your cup. And you have not withheld the pasture from the worm, nor the worm from the pasture — and this is the whole of your care, and it reaches the least of us.
3: My heart was pruned and its flower appeared; then grace sprang up in it, and it brought forth fruit to the Lord. For the Most High circumcised me by His Holy Spirit, and He uncovered my inward being toward Him, and He filled me with His love.

I went up into the light of truth as into a chariot, and the truth took me and carried me. It brought me over the chasms and the gulfs, and it saved me from the rocks and the waves. And it set me upon the heights of truth, and from the heights I saw the whole world — and the world was small, and the love that carried me was large, and that is all I remember of the journey.
